name: Metal Barns
description:
Why Choose Metal Barns Over Traditional Wooden Structures?

Metal barns are rapidly becoming the preferred choice for farmers and ranchers — and for good reason. Unlike wood, metal won’t warp, rot, or attract termites, meaning you’ll spend far less time and money on repairs and maintenance. Metal barns also provide superior resistance to harsh weather, keeping your equipment, animals, and supplies protected year-round. Built to last for decades with minimal upkeep, metal barns deliver long-term durability and reliable performance that wooden structures simply can’t match. Metal barns also offer far greater resistance to weather, so your equipment, animals, and supplies are protected from the elements year-round. They’re also built to last decades and require minimal maintenance along the way.

Custom Farm and Ranch Buildings

Your farm, your barn. Every customer has unique needs, which is why our barns are fully customizable to fit any lifestyle or operation. Design a space to store hay, shelter livestock, house equipment, host events, or simply keep vehicles out of the weather — the choice is yours. When designing your building, you have complete control over size, layout, roofing style, color scheme, doors, windows, trim, wainscoting, and more. Adjust every detail to suit your needs and make the structure truly your own. With this level of customization, the possibilities are virtually limitless. When you design your building, you’ll have full control over your building’s size, layout, roofing type, color scheme, doors, windows, trim and wainscoting, and much more. Change it, adjust it, and make it your own. There are no limits when you're working with this level of customizability.

Metal Barn Kits Durability Saves Time and Money

Farmers require barns that endure years of intense use and extreme weather with minimal upkeep needs. Top Goat Metal Structures steel barns deliver durability and longevity, exceeding traditional wooden buildings. Designed to be weather and wear-resistant inside and out using the highest-grade American steel and engineered foundations, our prefab barns save agricultural producers time, labor, and money over the long run, providing a secure and reliable investment for your farm.

Metal Barn Kit Styles

When choosing the perfect metal barn, Top Goat Metal Structures offers diverse styles aligned to needs – such as our famous Horse Barns optimized for equine care, Carolina Barns featuring signature curved sides, and practical Seneca Barns with a continuous roof. The purpose is to build for agricultural functions yet provide attractive additions to any landscape and customize dimensions, colors, and components like tack rooms or storage lofts. We construct an individualized barn around priorities like seamlessly integrating temperature-controlled offices, custom stables, animal stalls, wide vehicle doors, and workshop areas for managing machinery repairs in-house. No matter your needs, our metal barn specialists are here to help you understand which type is best for you.

Horse Barns

Quality horse barns remain essential for securing rider investments even on multi-use farms. Top Goat Metal Structures consultants determine ideal barn dimensions, features, and placement based on your equestrian operation’s specialization – whether a small hobby stable or a full-scale boarding facility. All our barns blend durability with design to accommodate horse-specific needs like hay storage, tack rooms, and kick walls.

Carolina Barns

Top Goat Metal Structures offers Carolina Barns featuring an A-frame–centered aisle ideal for equestrian operations. This understated yet stately design provides owners, handlers, and horses with a protected common area between facing stalls, promoting a sense of community and ease of movement. The raised center aisle offers ample overhead clearance for mounted riders and creates a comfortable space for grooming without confinement. Built with durable, long-lasting steel, our Carolina Barns withstand heavy daily use and deliver reliable protection from the diverse weather conditions of changing seasons year after year.

Seneca Barns

Seneca Barns feature A-frame roofs in either vertical or practical boxed-eave orientations, unified under one continuous roofline. This efficient design blends sturdy functionality with clean aesthetics. Our specialists can recommend the ideal framing, roof style, and height to suit your climate and specific operational needs.

All Steel Barns from Top Goat Metal Structures Represent Quality and Trust

When you buy from Warrior, you’re investing in more than just a structure. You’re investing in lasting quality, craftsmanship, and a dedication to customer service that doesn’t quit. Here’s what you get when you buy a Warrior Building:
  • 1-Year Workmanship Warranty
We're proud of our work, and we stand by it. Our professional installation crews will bring your building to life quickly, correctly, and effortlessly, or we’ll make it right. This 1-year workmanship warranty covers any issues related to the installation of your barn.
  • 10-Year Panel Warranty Against Chipping and Cracking
Our 10-year warranty covers any chipping or cracking on your paneling, so you can rest easy knowing your structure is ready to take on the elements around you.
  • 20-Year Rust-Through Warranty
Our 20-year rust-through warranty guarantees you'll have a long-lasting structure that's as tough as the work you put into it.
  • 14 Custom Color Options
You deserve a barn that complements your property's aesthetic, and our 14 color options make it easy to find the perfect shade. Pick a color that feels just right for your farm, and know your barn will look great for years to come.
  • Extensive Customization Options
From the layout to the finishing touches, we give you the power to design the barn that’s right for you. Choose from custom sizes, color schemes, wainscoting, trim, ventilation solutions, and more to create a barn that’s uniquely yours.
  • Flexible Financing Options
Top Goat Metal Structures works with trusted lenders to bring you financing options that are easy, hassle-free, and rewarding. We offer payment terms of 24 to 72 months, with loans up to $50,000 with approved credit.
  • Rent-to-Own Options
For those that want to forego traditional financing, we offer rent-to-own packages on select structures. Our RTO plans feature fast approvals, no hard credit checks, and no penalties for early payoff. Just pay your way and enjoy your Warrior building the way it was meant to be. Whether you’re creating a space to store oversized tractors and equipment, or you want to comfortable place to house your horses and livestock, Top Goat Metal Structures is proud to be a name you can trust. Our steel structures and metal barn kits are built with premium materials, customized to suit your style, and engineered to get the job done right.

description:
Our Metal Carports Feature

When you invest in Top Goat Metal Structures, you’re getting more than a car cover– you’re getting a storage solution that’s designed to go the distance. Here’s what’s included with every carport we sell:
  1. Concrete or Rebar Anchors for StabilityOur anchor systems secure your metal carport to its foundation. Whether you go with soil, asphalt, or concrete as your foundation type, we'll make sure it is properly anchored down.
  2. A 1-Year Craftsmanship WarrantyWe stand behind the quality of our work! Our 1-year craftsmanship warranty guarantees that your steel building is constructed quickly, efficiently, and most importantly– correctly!
  3. A 10 to 20-Year Warranty on Framing and PanelingOur metal carports are built to last. That’s why we back our framing and paneling with extensive warranties for lasting protection.
  4. Choice Between 14 Color OptionsChoose from a variety of colors to match your style or property aesthetic. Or mix and match for some unforgettable color schemes!
  5. Virtual 3D Modeling Program for Easy CustomizationVisualize your customizations before you buy! Our 3D Builder allows you to view, edit, and perfect your structure in real time from the comfort of your computer or smartphone.
  6. Custom Features and AccessoriesAdd extra features like gable ends, side panels, or doors and windows to personalize your metal carport further.
  7. Financing and Rent-to-Own PackagesWe offer accessible financing and Rent-to-Own options so you can get the carport you need without breaking the bank.
  8. Included Delivery and InstallationDon’t worry about hiring third-party contractors! We’ll handle it all. Just schedule your installation, prep your foundation, and leave the rest to us!

Residential Metal Carports vs. Commercial Carports

In most cases, the differences between residential and commercial metal carports are minimal. Both typically share the same overall design and are built using the same high-quality materials. The primary differences lie in the configuration, paneling, and framing. For example, the industry-standard framing thickness for residential structures is 14-gauge steel. However, commercial metal carports—especially those expected to handle heavier use—benefit from thicker 12-gauge framing for added strength and durability. The same principle applies to paneling. Most residential carports use 29-gauge steel paneling, while commercial applications or installations in areas with severe weather conditions often require the sturdier 26-gauge paneling.

Top Goat Metal Structures Premium Carports

Discover Top Goat Metal Structures’ unrivaled carports constructed using top-tier galvanized steel and sheet metal. Explore superb single-car, two-car, and partially-enclosed carport options:

Convenient Single Car Carports

Our single-car shelters are designed for your convenience, starting at 12′ x 21′ with a generous 6-foot side clearance. They cover vehicles, recreational equipment, and more using sturdy steel gauge componentry. You can trust our carports’ ease of use and reliability, providing you with peace of mind and confidence in your purchase.

Spacious Two-Car Carports

With widths ranging from 18 to 24 feet, these versatile metal covers reliably protect two full-sized vehicles, oversized machinery such as tractors, and even RVs or boats.

Partially Enclosed Carports

Enhance protection from sun, wind, and other elements by adding galvanized steel gable ends, side panels, and customized garage-door walls to create partial or fully enclosed carport structures.

Utility Carports

Utility carports offer perfect protected storage by merging shelters with enclosed lockable areas in 5-foot customizable increments to maximize utilization. Easily convert regular carports into versatile utility buildings matching specific space requirements. Experience the ultimate carport convenience and functionality to securely house vehicles, equipment, and valuables.

Carport Functionality: Storage, Shade & Shelter

Our carports provide more than just vehicle parking, offering versatile mixed-use spaces. Discover the practical and recreational possibilities today and get excited about the potential of your outdoor space. Our carports can adapt to your changing needs and enhance your outdoor living experience. Reliably store valuable vehicles like cars, boats, and trailers under our galvanized steel shelters, providing a secure haven from the sun, storms, and extreme weathering that can lead to damage. Our carports offer protection that will give you peace of mind. Install party-ready carports to transform outdoor entertainment patios and pavilions by adding customizable shade options. These carports can easily cover gathering areas exposed to relentless rays. Appreciate year-round mediation from difficult environmental conditions like heavy snow, rain, sweltering heat, or bitter cold enjoyed by people, animals, and belongings taking refuge inside our broadly protective structures.

name: RV Garages
description:
What is an RV Garage?

As you can imagine, an RV garage is a metal building that’s designed to accommodate recreational vehicles, motorhomes, and campers. These garages are taller, wider, and more spacious than standard garages to give you ample room for your RV. Beyond just size, RV garages are engineered to provide superior protection from harsh weather, UV rays, and other elements that can take a toll on your investment. With added features like customizable entry points and reinforced framing, an RV garage is an ideal storage solution for adventurers who want peace of mind when their RV is not on the road.

Customization Options for RV Garages

RV garages from Top Goat Metal Structures are as unique as the people who own them. Our customization options let you create a structure that suits your needs and matches your personal style. Let’s explore all the ways you can customize yours:
  • Size and Dimensions: Choose the perfect height, width, and length to fit your RV and any additional items you'd like to store.
  • Doors and Entryways: Add roll-up doors, walk-in doors, or side-entry options for easy access and convenience.
  • Roof Styles: Select from regular, boxed-eave, or vertical roof designs to suit your aesthetic preferences and local weather conditions.
  • Colors and Finishes: Personalize your RV garage with a variety of color options for the walls, roof, and trim to complement your home or property.
  • Insulation: Protect your RV from extreme temperatures with insulation options that help regulate the interior climate.

The Many Uses for RV Garages

RV garages aren’t just for storing RVs—they can serve a wide variety of purposes. Our customers regularly use them for:
  • Vehicle Protection: Store other vehicles, such as boats, trailers, or trucks, alongside your RV to keep them secure and sheltered.
  • Maintenance and Repairs: Use the space for DIY repairs or routine maintenance on your RV or other vehicles.
  • Storage Space: Safely store camping gear, tools, or other large items that need to be kept out of the elements.
  • Workshop or Hobby Space: Transform part of your RV garage into a dedicated space for woodworking, crafting, or other hobbies.

Top Goat Metal Structures is Your Premier Source for RV Garages

Top Goat Metal Structures offers industry-leading craftsmanship, durable materials, and customizable options to create a structure that’ll go just as far as the vehicle you plan to protect. We also want to make investing in your RV garage easy, and work with nationally recognized lenders to offer flexible financing options on all our buildings. With fast approval processes and no early payoff penalties, you can find a payment plan that works for you. Give your vehicle the armor it needs. Call Top Goat Metal Structures today at [site_phone] to start customizing your RV metal garage. We’ll walk you through the process from start to finish and show you why our buildings carry the name Warrior.
